page.content:
Wine-service professional — cellar, pairing, and the language of the list.

How Sommelier connects

  • Topic: Master Sommelier — The Master Sommelier title sits at the top of one sommelier exam culture.
  • Topic: Tasting-note culture — Sommeliers speak the shared vocabulary of tasting notes at the table.
  • Topic: Wine — The sommelier is the service profession that interprets wine for diners.

What is Sommelier?

The sommelier is the floor and cellar craft: service temperature, decanting, and translating terroir for a table. Master-sommelier exams made the job a title.

Key threads lead to Master Sommelier, Tasting-note culture and Wine.
